title_as_printed: Experimental Isopiestic Molalities Calculated Water Activities and Actual Temperatures
pressure_note: isopiestic equilibrium at the vapour pressure of the solutions (saturation); no pressure column

value.what: total molality of the KCl + MgCl2 mixture at isopiestic equilibrium (sum of both solutes, mol per kg H2O; the paper says 'total equilibrium molalities')

value2.what: molality of the reference electrolyte MgCl2 in the isopiestic equilibrium

aw.what: water activity calculated from the MgCl2 reference molality with the equation of Valyashko et al.

composition.other_species: salt mole fraction y_KCl = n_KCl/(n_MgCl2 + n_KCl) (Eq. 1), given in block label rows; mixtures prepared at constant MgCl2:KCl ratio; individual molalities are not printed

conversion_needs: m_KCl = y_KCl * m(Total), m_MgCl2 = (1 - y_KCl) * m(Total) if m(Total) is the sum of the two solute molalities (to be confirmed from paper text 'Total equilibrium molalities')
temperature is printed per row (actual temperature of each isopiestic run, about 428.1-428.7 K, nominal 155.5 C)
notes: Label rows printed as 'y_KCl = 0.05' etc. (text layer gives YKCl). Replicate rows (same reference molality, slightly different total) are kept. Carried values: none.
